question: On the kit as it is on main (06b0b92), how do its seven eval scenarios do on claude-haiku-5-5, run after run? This is the baseline that tells a regression on this branch from a scenario that already fails or shows no difference on main.
machine: cloud-linux: Claude Code cloud container, Linux 6.18, Node 22.23.5, Claude Code 2.1.330, signed in with the owner's own login (no API key)
command: in a checkout of main at 06b0b92 with cli/kit bundled:  node evals/run.mjs --model claude-haiku-5-5 --results-dir <this folder>/raw   (three times), then   node research/agile-flow/runs/2026-11-23-evals/to-csv.mjs 2026-11-23-evals-main

metrics.name: checks_passed
metrics.how: the scenario's checks that passed in this arm

metrics.name: scenario_pass
metrics.how: on the 'with' case only: 1 when the harness's verdict for the scenario is pass, 0 for fail or no-difference

metrics.name: cost_usd
metrics.how: Claude Code's own estimate for the run, not a bill

notes: Written after the first of the three runs of 2026-11-23-evals, which showed three of the seven older scenarios not passing on this branch (build-tdd-fence, review-weakened-test, wireframe-gate). That first result is why this baseline exists, so it was not planned blind.
Same harness defaults as that run: 12 turns, 240 seconds and 0.50 USD per run. The harness and scenarios are main's own.
The 'without' arm is the same in both runs: no kit. Only the 'with' arm differs.
